english.title: Cause/permit incorrect signature to be furnished to returning officer for use in election
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were guilty of a corrupt practice in that you caused or permitted a signature purporting to be that of an elector, namely **(..SPECIFY PURPORTED ELECTOR..),

(A)_[proposing]_
(B)_[seconding]_
(C)_[assenting to]_

the nomination of a candidate, namely **(..SPECIFY CANDIDATE..) at a

(D)_[parliamentary]_
(E)_[local government]_

election, to be included in a document delivered or furnished to a returning officer for use in that election, knowing that the signature

(F)_[was not written by that elector]_
(G)_[,although written by the elector, was not done so for the purpose of proposing that candidate's nomination]_
(H)_[,although written by the elector, was not done so for the purpose of seconding that candidate's nomination]_
(I)_[,although written by the elector, was not done so for the purpose of assenting to that candidate's nomination]_
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 65A(1)(b) and 168 of the Representation of the People Act 1983.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
causes/permits to be included in a document
delivered/otherwise furnished to a returning officer
for use in connection with the election
anything which purports to be the signature of an elector
who proposes/seconds/assents to
the nomination of such a candidate
but which you knew was not written by the elector
by whom it purports to have been written or
if written by that elector was not written by him
for the purpose of signifying that he was
proposing/seconding/assenting to that candidate's nomination

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Section 65A(2) for the definition of a relevant election as it applies to this offence.
(iii) This offence has been inserted by paragraph 5 of Schedule 6 to the Representation of the People Act 2000.

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
